sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Sudhir Kumar Jain
 Order
% 10.11.2023 Crl.M.A. 30977/2023 (exemption)

1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR bearing no. 0181/2017 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Samaipur Badli along with consequential proceedings.

5. Mr. Naresh Kumar Chahar, Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by the Investigating Officer Insp. Naveen Kumar, P.S. Samaipur Badli, accepts notice on behalf of the State/respondent no. 1.
6.
Let notice be issued to the respondent no. 2 on taking necessary steps by the petitioner within 02 weeks from today through all permissible modes,
